featured.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design
featured.tldr: A matched-budget study of looped language models finds that looping a middle block between untied input and output layers works best, and that the advantage carries over to mixture-of-experts models.

featured.title: One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models
featured.tldr: Elastic Latent Recurrence trains a looped language model whose single checkpoint matches a standard model at one loop and gains accuracy with each extra loop, giving a compute dial without extra output tokens.

featured.title: Recurrent Looped Transformer
featured.tldr: The Recurrent Looped Transformer feeds each token's final decoder state into the next token, letting a transformer's computation depth grow with sequence length and solve state-tracking tasks that a standard transformer fails.

featured.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
featured.tldr: ALoDLM lets a diffusion language model spend extra recurrent computation only on hard-to-predict tokens, beating comparable Qwen3 autoregressive models on average across 11 benchmarks with about 2.7x the throughput on GSM8K.
